description: Sync a Mailchimp account's sent campaigns with their email text, its audience lists and its classic automations. Each campaign links to the list it was sent to.
opening: Sync a Mailchimp account's sent email campaigns, audience lists and classic automations. Each campaign is one document with its settings, open and click rates, and the email text. Each campaign links to the audience list it was sent to.

Mailchimp permissions are not imported, so every synced item is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Draft and scheduled campaigns, audience members, and the emails inside automations are not synced. Items deleted in Mailchimp stay in HydraDB.

credentials.name: api_key
credentials.text: A Mailchimp API key, complete with its data center suffix, such as `-us21`. HydraDB finds your account's Mailchimp address from that suffix.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste the whole Mailchimp API key, including the data center suffix after the last `-`, as `api_key`.

steps.title: Configure the connector
steps.text: HydraDB lists one account-wide resource, All data. Select it to sync the whole account.

connect.account: One connector reads one Mailchimp account.

sync.first_sync: Reads every sent campaign, audience list and automation in the account, whatever their age.
sync.changes: Every sync reads all sent campaigns, lists and automations again. Open and click rates are refreshed on each sync.
sync.edits: A changed campaign, list or automation replaces its document.
sync.deletes: Deleted items are not removed. A campaign, list or automation deleted in Mailchimp stays searchable in HydraDB.
notes: Each sent campaign's email text is read with a separate request. If that request fails, the campaign is indexed with its settings only, and email text indexed on an earlier sync is replaced. Some failures, such as a refused request or a request that keeps timing out, can fail the whole sync.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.mailchimp_id
shared_attributes.text: The Mailchimp id of the campaign, list or automation. Targets one item. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's items. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: stream_type
shared_attributes.text: The record type, `campaigns`, `lists` or `automations`, shown when you inspect the item. No published filter limits a query by record type.

documents.name: Campaigns
documents.one_document: One sent campaign, with its email text when Mailchimp returns it.
documents.title: The campaign's internal title, else its subject line, else `Mailchimp campaigns <id>`.
documents.text: The title, then `Subject`, `Preview`, `From`, `List`, `Type`, `Status`, `Sent`, `Open rate` and `Click rate` lines, with the rates as percentages. Then the email text: Mailchimp's plain-text version, or the HTML converted to text when there is no plain-text version.
documents.date: When the campaign was sent, or when it was created if there is no send time.
documents.files: None. Images and files in the email are not fetched. Only the text is kept.

attributes.name: Email text
attributes.text: The full email message, from the plain-text version or the converted HTML. The original plain-text and HTML content are not kept on the item.

attributes.name: settings
attributes.text: The campaign's title, subject line, preview text and sender name, written as the title and the `Subject`, `Preview` and `From` lines.

attributes.name: recipients
attributes.text: The audience list the campaign was sent to. Its name is written as the `List` line, and its id links the campaign to that list.

attributes.name: report_summary
attributes.text: Open and click rates, written as percentages. They are a snapshot from the latest sync.

attributes.name: type, status
attributes.text: The campaign type and status, written as the `Type` and `Status` lines.

attributes.name: send_time
attributes.text: When the campaign was sent, written as the `Sent` line. It sets the result date.

attributes.name: create_time
attributes.text: When the campaign was created. Sets the result date only when there is no send time. Not searchable.

attributes.name: Other campaign fields
attributes.text: Every other field of the campaign, such as `emails_sent` and tracking settings. Kept for inspection only.

documents.name: Audience lists
documents.one_document: One audience list. Its members are not synced.
documents.title: The list name, or `Mailchimp lists <id>` when there is none.
documents.text: The title, then `Permission Reminder`, `Members` and `Created` lines.
documents.link_back: The list's public signup form, not the list in Mailchimp.

attributes.name: name
attributes.text: The list name, written as the title and the first line.

attributes.name: permission_reminder
attributes.text: The list's permission reminder: its explanation of how people signed up or gave permission.

attributes.name: stats.member_count
attributes.text: How many members the list has, written as the `Members` line.

attributes.name: date_created
attributes.text: When the list was created, written as the `Created` line. It sets the result date.

attributes.name: Other list fields
attributes.text: Every other field of the list, such as its stats, contact details and campaign defaults. Kept for inspection only.

documents.name: Classic automations
documents.one_document: One automation. The emails inside it are not synced.
documents.title: The automation's title, or `Mailchimp automations <id>` when there is none.
documents.text: The title, then `From`, `Status`, `Emails Sent` and `Started` lines.
documents.date: When the automation started, or when it was created if there is no start time.

attributes.name: settings
attributes.text: The automation's title and sender name, written as the title and the `From` line.

attributes.name: status, emails_sent
attributes.text: The automation's status and how many emails it has sent, as of the latest sync.

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.text: When the automation started, written as the `Started` line. It sets the result date.

attributes.name: create_time
attributes.text: When the automation was created. Sets the result date only when there is no start time. Not searchable.

attributes.name: Other automation fields
attributes.text: Every other field of the automation. Kept for inspection only.

example_searches: What did the Black Friday campaign email say, and what was its subject line?
What were the open and click rates of last month's newsletter?
Which automations are running, and how many emails have they sent?

connections: A campaign to the audience list it was sent to.
graph.people: No people or groups are attached to items. Audience members are not synced.
graph.from_text: Campaign email text, and the settings of each campaign, list and automation.

not_synced: Draft, scheduled and other campaigns that were not sent.
Audience members, segments, segment members and unsubscribes.
Per-recipient email activity, such as who opened or clicked.
The individual emails inside an automation.
Images and attachments inside campaign emails.
Deletions: items deleted in Mailchimp stay in HydraDB.
